सैरंध्रः, सैरिंध्रः
1 A menial servant
or attendant.
--2 A mixed tribe,
the offspring of a Dasyu and an
Ayogava female; सैरिंध्रं वागुरावृत्तिं
सूते दस्युरयोगवे

सैरंध्री, सैरिंध्री
1 A maidservant or
female attendant in the women's
apartments (a woman of the mixed
tribe described in सैरंध्र 2).
--2 An
independent female artisan working
in another person's house.
--3 An
epithet of Draupadī (assumed by
her when she acted as servant to
Sudeṣṇā^1, queen of Virāṭa.).
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20240609. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/.
